# Ridu 0.11.0

This release lets applications hide collections and globals from the admin without changing their
API behavior, and removes the need for migrations when only admin presentation settings change.

## Changes

- Set `CollectionAdmin.Hidden` or `GlobalAdmin.Hidden` to omit a resource from admin navigation,
  the dashboard, and search. Its admin routes show not-found, including custom document views.
- Hidden resources remain available through REST, GraphQL, and the Local API. Access rules, hooks,
  cascading deletes, and relationship selection/editing still apply. Hiding a resource is a
  presentation choice; use access rules to restrict its data.
- Relationships to hidden resources keep their labels and editor flows without links to admin
  pages that do not exist.
- Migration currentness and production readiness ignore explicit `Admin` presentation metadata
  on collections, globals, fields, and blocks. Changing settings such as `Hidden` or `Group`
  therefore needs no migration. Storage-schema drift and migration-ledger corruption still fail
  readiness checks.
- Production migration fingerprints bind the ordered artifact identities, recorded head digest,
  and schema with admin presentation removed.

## Breaking change and upgrade

Update the Go module and every Ridu npm package to 0.11.0 together, regenerate application
contracts, and rebuild with the matching CLI.

`migration.DigestArtifactHistory` now requires three arguments: the ordered artifact identities,
the recorded head manifest digest, and the manifest. Its fingerprint encoding has changed. Update
custom Go callers and recompute manually embedded migration-history fingerprints. Applications
built through `ridu build` receive the new fingerprint automatically.

Persisted migration artifacts and database ledgers retain their existing encodings. Do not rewrite
them to adopt this release. Admin-only changes require no new migration; use the ordinary migration
workflow for application storage-schema changes. Manifest, protocol, and plugin format/API counters
remain unchanged.
